name: Main car park north entrance · gatehouse windows and wing walls, signs, plinth, lantern, notice pillar and planting
about: Pieces at the car park's north entrance round the gatehouse island (data/picasso_car_park.json gatehouse, data/ground_plan_picasso.json). 'wings' and 'plinth' are structure, drawn in Layout; the rest is Show details. Positions are map metres (+x east, +z south); 'face' is the outward normal of a sign or plinth face as [x, z]. Read from Dave's Street View screenshots (Oct 2024, Imagery © Google, reference/google-maps/03, 04, 06-08), the Google 3D top-down view registered to the aerial (reference/google-maps/05, about 1.5 m) and IMG_3131. Drawn by src/picasso-entrance-details.ts.

windows.basis: Arched window with black iron bars on the face towards Calle Bolivia, centred, its sill about knee height (Street View 06, 07, 08).
A matching grilled window on the face towards Calle Loira (Street View 03); whether it is the same opening seen round the corner is not certain.

plaque.basis: Small blue plaque right of the north-east window (Street View 07).

wings.basis: Sloping white wing wall continuing the gatehouse's north-east face towards the exit barrier's cabinet (Street View 06, 08). Length and heights judged against the cabinet and signs; estimated.
Sloping white wing wall from the gatehouse's west corner towards the entry barrier's cabinet, beside the STOP sign (Street View 03, 06). Direction and length estimated.

signs.basis: STOP sign on the island beside the gatehouse, facing Calle Loira (Street View 03, 06; IMG_3131 shows the island edge).
White arrow sign ACCESO PLAYA / TO THE BEACH pointing left, on its own post on the island lawn (Street View 03).
No-entry sign on a post above the exit barrier's cabinet, facing Calle Bolivia (Street View 04, 08).
Blue dead-end (T) sign on a post at the long wall's north end, facing Calle Bolivia (Street View 08).
Board on two posts reading COMUNIDAD VILLACANA with the community's emblem, at the island's north-east edge by the exit lane (Street View 07, 08).

pillar.basis: White pillar at the narrow planter's south end carrying a notice sheet and a blue ZONA VIDEOVIGILADA plate, facing the entry lane (Street View 03).

plinth.basis: White rendered plinth with CALLE DE PICASSO in black tiles near its top, standing on the lawn strip facing the entry lane (IMG_3131). Position from the white block in the Google top-down view, within about 1 m of IMG_3131's corrected camera reading; size judged in IMG_3131.

lantern.basis: The resort's lantern post just behind and right of the plinth (IMG_3131), at the lawn strip's north end; position estimated.

planting.basis: Giant strelitzia clump in front of the north-east window (Street View 06, 07).
Strelitzia west of the gatehouse (Street View 06, 07).
Strelitzia on the north side of the bed (Street View 06).
Sago palms at the west end of the lawn bed (Street View 06).
Sago palms at the west end of the lawn bed (Street View 06).
Feathery-leaved tree at the island's north-east, over the community board (Street View 07, 08; a crown in the Google top-down view).
Tall palm rising behind the feathery tree (Street View 07, 08).
Bougainvillea in the narrow planter (Street View 03).
Bougainvillea in the narrow planter (Street View 03; IMG_3131's pink flowers beyond the rest post).
